title: the AbstractClassDescriptor base-aware constructors, one row per member
heading: ## Per-member rows: the class name and size each base-aware descriptor constructor registers (OPUS, 2026-10-03)
lead: The family `AbstractClassDescriptor base-aware constructors` (frontmatter: 132 members; {N} get a row here) shares one form, not repeated per row. It calls the two context getters, passes them to the shared descriptor constructor `00632D80` with the class name in `r8` and the instance size in `r9d`, stores the concrete vtable, sets bit `0x2` of dword `+0xFC`, and calls the three member-registration helpers. What differs from member to member is the name and size it passes. Each row anchors the `lea r8, [S]` before the `00632D80` call (the member's distinguishing instruction) and states S, the class-name string at S, and the immediate size from `mov r9d`. All are read from the certified image. {CHECK} re-derives every row and compares it with the committed {ROWS}. A body without exactly one `00632D80` call, a name that is not a clean string, or a value that differs fails it. Two controls are refused: a swapped value and a moved anchor. Members that do not derive are listed in [`excluded.tsv`](../../_index/candidates/opus-ee-base-aware-ctors-1003/excluded.tsv).
